AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Aircraft Stability, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Stability.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Stability.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Stability.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Stability.

2. When learning Aircraft Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Systems.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Systems.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Systems.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Systems.

3. When learning Aviation Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Security.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Security.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Security.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Security.

4. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

6. When learning Aviation Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Entrepreneurship.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

8. When learning Flight Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Safety.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Flight Safety.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

11. When learning Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

12. When learning Cargo Handling, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cargo Handling.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cargo Handling.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Cargo Handling.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cargo Handling.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Stability and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Simulated Flying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Cargo Handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
